title: Angular & Java Developer
description:
Angular \& Java Developer

Experience: 4–7\+ Years

Location: Pune – ICC Park, Shivajinagar or PAN India

Employment: Contract / FTE

Contract Duration: 6 Months

Budget for contract: ₹80K/month

Budget for FTE : Upto 10LPA

Job Summary:

Looking for an experienced Angular \& Java Developer to develop and maintain scalable applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular and Microservices.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain applications using Java, Spring Boot \& Angular.

Design and build REST APIs and backend services for scalable systems.

Develop responsive UI components using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML \& CSS.

Work on large\-scale distributed systems and Microservices architecture.

Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementations.

Perform coding, debugging, testing and performance optimization.

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an Agile environment.

Participate in code reviews and maintain quality standards.

MongoDB, Azure \& CI/CD Pipelines knowledge will be an advantage.

Mandatory Technical Skills:

Backend: Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate

Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

Database: MySQL, Oracle, SQL

APIs: RESTful Services, Microservices

Tools: Git, Maven/Gradle, Eclipse/VS Code, Tomcat/JBoss

Interested candidates can share their CV at:

hrtrinexglobal@gmail.com

Pay: Up to ₹80,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
